session: Plan 3 acceptance 1: first-sight split, a timed fast over accelerated game days (energy, partition, weight both sides, flags), the band crossing and push, the weight re-assertion, the legacy mirror on and off, the energy-state hunger floor, cost; one boot of x14-body at DayLength 1

profile.name: x14-body
profile.description: PZTestKit + NutritionRevamp (Mode 1, LegacyMirror) + TKX_MetWatch, DayLength 1 - the body acceptance.

deviations: Controls during the fast: thirst and fatigue pinned to 0 every cycle; the health-from-food timer written to 20000 every 3 cycles so the level-4 HUNGRY drain cannot kill the subject before the band crossing (~158 game hours); none of the three is an input of the body model.
The client mirror is re-requested by calling the mod's own NutritionRevamp.client.requestMirror once through bench.global on the client (the first-sight mirror is sent before record.body exists).
Speed through RCON settimespeed (the broadcast command, #1870), not time.multiplier.
The band watch's boundary wall is ESTIMATED from the server's (worldAge, wall) pairs; the close runs at the first slow minute after the boundary (<= one game minute, 0.125 s wall at speed 5).

world_changes.restored: the golden fixture restored into the run dir
left_in_place: a lettuce, a bread and an apple eaten
NR.LegacyMirror false in the live server config

steps.args: global:NutritionRevamp.players admin.body.fm admin.body.lm admin.body.l0 admin.body.traitCarry admin.body.sex admin.body.band admin.body.dayIndex admin.body.r

B.predicted: >=3 closes; eb7<0; fm,lm fall; partition law exact (1e-6); per-close loss within 10% of the live prediction; server weight == fm+lm (1e-3); dec true both sides after the first close
B.falsifier: any of the predicted relations reversed

C.predicted: bandChanges 0->1 at the crossing close, the trait both sides, client within 1 s; bandRepairs 0

observed.note: no band change during the fast

D.falsifier: a server read of 120 more than 2 game minutes after the set

F.falsifier: hunger 0 (or the no-floor form) at fill 1 with E > 1

E1.falsifier: a store away from mirrorLast beyond the read-gap tolerance
